about_the_game:
SPEAR – Original Soundtrack (OST)
By Pierwolf

14 tracks. All bangers.

Ever wondered what it sounds like inside the mind of a slightly traumatized NPC trying to save a collapsing video game world with a stick? Neither did we. But here we are.

The SPEAR OST is a genre-hopping rollercoaster that slaps you with rock, fantasy vibes, and… whatever that weird track was. It’s music for dodging bugs, fixing broken quests, and questioning your life choices.

🎧 What’s inside?

  • 14 original tracks composed by Pierwolf (who clearly has range and possibly unresolved issues)

  • From face-melting riffs to delicate melodies that scream “emotional damage”

  • Perfect for working out, crying in the shower, or watching your game crash in slow motion

Whether you’re swinging a spear, helping depressed NPCs, or just vibing through the digital apocalypse—this soundtrack’s got your existential crisis covered.

Light a virtual candle, pop your headphones on, and embrace the chaos.
